item.title: Email Organization
item.description: Email Organization Currently, I have my main GMail account and another one on FastMail, which I use for friends-n-family email. As I’ve said, my current GMail account has become an unmanageable spam magnet. So, how to set things up such that my email becomes manageable again? Requirements Here’s what I’d like to have: Personal account for friends and family Corporate/professional account for businesses and such An account specific for Google Services such as Photos, Drive, etc.
